correctness.rationale: The integer Sylvester determinant is exactly R=P²−QT. In characteristic two, the six derivatives are eT,eP,eQ,bT,bP,bQ. Since Q,T lie in (b,e), adjoining R yields J=(P,Q,T)(b,e,P) without saturation or radicalization. The rank-one two-by-three minors give a smooth Segre S; its polar-zero Cartier divisor E is smooth. On a=1, P=r,Q=s,T=yr−xs and full Tjurina J=(r,s)(y,r,s)=(r,s)∩(y,r,s)². Every point of E has an analogous regular local parameter chart. This yields exactly the two associated subvarieties S and E and the rank-two conormal embedded sheaf. Restricting y=0 gives k[r,s]/(r,s)² of length three. SymPy independently computes the Sylvester determinant, all derivatives, both Groebner ideal containments and the local normal form; an F2 enumeration confirms the reduced rank-one support but is not used as a proof of infinite-field assertions.

originality.rationale: The claimed novelty is the full characteristic-two Tjurina ideal product and intrinsic embedded polar-zero conormal divisor, not the classical resultant equation, generic rank-one support, or characteristic-zero theory. The 2006 D’Andrea–Chipalkatti §5 resultant theorem is formulated over C and concerns a partial-coefficient Jacobian ideal; its perfection assertion does not imply the modular embedded component. Statnik’s 2021 paper explicitly studies complex sparse resultants and reduced singular strata/generic transverse types, not the modular full Tjurina ideal. Targeted index and primary-literature searches found no equivalent claim; residual historical-priority uncertainty is recorded.

value.rationale: The universal binary-quadratic resultant is a canonical quartic whose reduced singular locus is a well-understood smooth Segre. The exact intrinsic positive-characteristic scheme exhibits a rank-two conormal embedded divisor over the coordinate-free vanishing-polar locus, failure of Cohen–Macaulayness, and a length-three transverse fiber versus reduced length one away from that divisor. This is a natural structural singular-scheme invariant, not just a coordinate substitution, small arithmetic table, or nonmotivated finite check.
